title: Open Enrollment 2027

## Open Enrollment 2027


# Your Benefits. Your Choice.


##### Important Details


## Open Enrollment Dates
Enrollment Period:


## October 21 – November 8, 2027


### All benefit elections must be submitted by 11:59 PM CST on November 8.


Open Enrollment is your annual opportunity to review your benefits and make changes for the upcoming plan year. Take a few minutes to explore your options and ensure your coverage meets your needs.


## What You Need to Do:


-


Review your current benefit elections


-


Compare available medical, dental, and vision plans


-


Update dependent information if needed


-


Enroll or make changes before the deadline


## What's New This Year:


- Updated medical plan options
- Expanded virtual care through Teladoc
- Enhanced wellness benefits
- Flexible Spending Account contribution updates
- Revised prescription drug coverage


##### Helpful Resources


 2027 Benefits Guide Medical Plan Comparison Dental & Vision Overview Employee Cost Calculator


This information is provided for general employee reference and may be subject to change. Official AZZ policies, plans, and communications govern when applicable.
